title: Informationsarchitektur und zentrale Interaktionen gestalten (P00.03)
ui: App navigation, object handoffs, light/dark themes, responsive layout and status/empty/error states form the interactive prototype.
boundary: Product-owner design approval and representative-user evaluation remain manual acceptance.

title: Repository, App-Shell und Entwicklungsumgebungen anlegen (P01.01)
ui: React 19 / TypeScript / Vite 8 app shell, shadcn/ui primitives, reusable components and direct client routing.
boundary: No Convex registration, cloud deployment, production domains or secret-bearing backend.

title: Authentifizierung und Workspace-Isolation umsetzen (P01.02)
ui: Local login/registration, email confirmation/reset flow previews, GitHub sign-in button and error/session-expired scenarios.
boundary: No real authentication, account creation, OAuth, email delivery or server-side tenant isolation.

title: Onboarding, Profile und Navigation bauen (P01.03)
ui: Four-step onboarding, skip/later paths, project, language, timezone, audience, tone/topics, optional GitHub/research and mock social activation.
boundary: Context is browser-local. No data transfer or real activation.

title: Content-Domain und Composer entwickeln (P02.01)
ui: Search/status/channel filters, single-post/thread editor, post ordering, unsaved-edit warning, save/reopen, immutable content versions, account assignment, preview and version restoration.
boundary: Persistence is localStorage; cross-user collaborative concurrency is not implemented. No real publishing.

title: Versionsgebundene Freigaben einführen (P02.02)
ui: Explicit version/account approval and revoke, working-versus-scheduled snapshot distinction; content/account/media changes invalidate current approval.
boundary: Local domain operations only; no backend audit or publication claim.

title: R2-Medienverwaltung mit Inhaltsbindung umsetzen (P02.03)
ui: Local file validation/upload progress/cancel/retry, image/video previews, media selection and alt text; referenced alt-text edits make new media/content versions.
boundary: No R2 URLs, server finalization, checksums, multipart upload or provider media processing. Demo limits: 2 MB/file, 3 MB total.

title: X-OAuth und Capability-Status implementieren (P03.01)
ui: Mock social account connection, reconnect/disconnect and account/instance metadata.
boundary: No X OAuth/PKCE/tokens/refresh. Connection labels explicitly describe simulated publishing.

title: Scheduler und Freigabeprüfung bauen (P03.02)
ui: Local schedule/reschedule/cancel, explicit timezone, future-date validation, duplicate slot checks and ambiguous/nonexistent DST time handling.
boundary: No scheduler, atomic server claim, remote jobs or exactly-once guarantee.

title: Publisher mit Einzelpost-Checkpoints und Abgleich bauen (P03.03)
ui: Immutable publication snapshots, per-post confirmed/unconfirmed thread states, partial/uncertain/error results, mock reconciliation and targeted continuation.
boundary: No external posts, provider retries or crash recovery proof; IDs are explicitly demo IDs.

title: Thread-Beiträge mit dauerhaften Versand-Checkpoints veröffentlichen (P03.03, Teil 2)
ui: Thread detail shows each contribution and confirmed checkpoint; local completion updates only pending mock contributions.
boundary: No durable backend checkpoints or external IDs.

title: Unklare Publishing-Ausgänge abgleichen und Teilthreads fortsetzen (P03.03, Teil 3)
ui: Uncertain outcomes require explicit mock reconciliation; partial/failed snapshots have continuation and snapshot review controls.
boundary: No provider reconciliation, real retry/backoff or remote duplicate-prevention evidence.

title: Kalender und erste betriebliche Rückmeldung liefern (P03.04)
ui: Week/month/agenda views, account/status filters, unscheduled drafts, move/cancel dialogs and keyboard alternative to dragging; successful/partial/uncertain statuses and next actions.
boundary: No real calendar jobs or critical email delivery.

title: GitHub-App und Repository-Auswahl anbinden (P04.01)
ui: GitHub-login and repository-App installation are separate mock controls; repository selection/monitoring, event scope and private-context consent.
boundary: No GitHub App permission synchronization or actual repository data.

title: Signale anreichern und verständlich darstellen (P04.03)
ui: Synthetic signal filters/details, original event versus editorial interpretation, relevance/novelty/confidence/private status, maintenance noise and failed enrichment, idea handoff.
boundary: No GitHub retrieval, secret filtering or AI enrichment.

title: Modellzugang, Budgets und sichere Tool-Verträge implementieren (P05.01)
ui: Supporting UI for mock run steps, cancellation, error/cost state and budget/usage previews.
boundary: No generative model adapter, token reservation, tool security, provider accounting or prompt-injection defense proof.

title: Ideen und Content Agent aufbauen (P05.02)
ui: Create/archive/accept local ideas with perspective/source; hand off note, signal or chat proposal into editable draft.
boundary: No Content Agent generation or factual verification.

title: Persistenten Chat und nachvollziehbare Agent-Arbeit liefern (P05.03)
ui: Account-scoped local conversations, simulated streaming/actions, stop/resume/error, linked draft proposal and mock step/cost states.
boundary: No Component threads, remote model streaming or token telemetry.

title: Research-Profile, Zeitsteuerung und Aufträge bauen (P06.01)
ui: Account-scoped research settings, project relevance, topic/audience/language/region/source/exclusion/freshness/count/frequency/budget, pause, mock next/last runs, immutable profile snapshot per local run.
boundary: No scheduled research or external lookup; frequency and next-run display preview configuration only.

title: X- und Websuche als getrennte Adapter anschließen (P06.02)
ui: Supporting empty/partial/source-failure/budget-result scenarios and transparent source/capability information.
boundary: No X/Web search adapters, live trends, provider cache or source-removal synchronization.

title: Research Agent, Evidenz und Themencluster implementieren (P06.03)
ui: Synthetic evidence separates source claims and interpretation; topic/freshness/confidence context and distinct run outcomes.
boundary: No research pipeline, evidence evaluation, semantic clustering or real trend detection.

title: Research-Evidenz und Gültigkeitsvertrag implementieren (P06.03, Teil 1)
ui: Source URLs, source claim, interpretation, confidence and freshness warning remain visible in local content handoff.
boundary: Demo URLs are marked example sources. No real evidence validity/expiry enforcement or removed-source feed.

title: Begrenzten Research-Workflow und Themencluster bauen (P06.03, Teil 2)
ui: Mock run start/cancel, completed/partial/budget/failed/empty outcomes, profile snapshot and optional local draft handoff.
boundary: No ten-step agent workflow, semantic deduplication or remote budget reservation.

title: Research Inbox und Übergabe in Content umsetzen (P06.04)
ui: Inbox filtering/detail, archive/ignore/update, ask-agent transition, create idea/draft and retained source chain; duplicate local handoffs reopen existing objects.
boundary: Updating a demo source changes local metadata; it performs no new research.

title: Pläne und Vorschlagslogik erstellen (P07.01)
ui: Plan-request form for account, count, starting date/time, source mix and pillar; limited fixed proposals with source/rationale, smaller plan if material is insufficient.
boundary: No AI plan generation or live editorial-context analysis.

title: Selektive Annahme und sichere Ausführung ermöglichen (P07.02)
ui: Review/edit proposals, independently approve concrete versions, select a subset and accept only selected slots; existing slots protected by local conflict checks.
boundary: No backend acceptance mutation, live source-freshness check or collaborative concurrency.

title: Versionierte Algorithmus- und Audience-Profile erstellen (P08.01)
ui: Profile/question/formula references, honest missing audience fit and cold-start marker; internal candidate/source review and profile version controls.
boundary: No verified X-algorithm model, embeddings, real audience signal or production profile activation.

title: Begrenzte Pre-Publish-Analyse implementieren (P08.02)
ui: Explicit mock analysis, current/stale/disabled/unavailable/low-confidence states, fixed dimensions and version/account identity.
boundary: No Jev call, normalized persisted provider assessment or real intelligence validation.

title: Jev-Adapter mit begrenzten Aufrufen und Betriebsflags implementieren (P08.02, Teil 1)
ui: Supporting disabled/provider-failure/low-confidence and local cost/bounded-attempt states.
boundary: No TypeSafe SDK integration, EU-only data-path approval, circuit breaker or provider accounting.

title: Jev-Post-Analyzer und reproduzierbaren Dispatch Score implementieren (P08.02, Teil 2)
ui: Hook/clarity/discussion/originality/natural CTA/structure/history dimensions, fixed weighted illustrative score, missing values and declared 50 cold-start standard.
boundary: All semantic values are hypothetical; no evaluated model, audience match or reach prediction.

title: Jev-Assessments versionsgebunden speichern und isoliert cachen (P08.02, Teil 3)
ui: Mock analysis identity binds draft/account/version; edited content marks result stale; obsolete local timers are cancelled.
boundary: No backend assessment schema, tenant-isolated cache, production retention or historical reproduction.

title: Empfehlungen, Vergleich und Übernahme gestalten (P08.03)
ui: Manual mock analysis does not change text; up to three explained recommendations with before/after review, explicit acceptance into a new unapproved version.
boundary: No generated recommendations, reach guarantee or automatic rewrite.

title: Messgrundlage bereits in der Beta schaffen (P08.04)
ui: Supporting missing-metric/unknown-value displays, local metric collection pause/delete and versioned composer analysis display.
boundary: No actual 24/48-hour metric snapshots or provider/publish-time assessment joins.

title: Betriebsereignisse, Alerts und Wiederherstellung konsolidieren (P09.01)
ui: Mock operational event log, correlation IDs, attention/error/uncertain states, repeat/reconcile previews and publishing next actions.
boundary: No live health monitor, alerts, runbooks exercise or provider recovery evidence.

title: Benachrichtigungen zuverlässig und konfigurierbar machen (P09.02)
ui: Local in-app issues/read state; email/in-app, weekly/research summary preferences and quiet times.
boundary: No emails, bounces, provider delivery lifecycle or executed quiet-time rules.

title: Export, Löschung und Retention umsetzen (P09.03)
ui: Active-workspace JSON export, retention preferences, scoped deletion confirmation/error/retry; account identity/membership deletion preserves shared contents.
boundary: No server data inventory, provider/R2 deletion, backups or legal retention execution.

title: Dateninventar und sicheren Workspace-Export liefern (P09.03, Teil 1)
ui: Export includes local workspace, accounts/content/plans/media/preferences and scoped local feature settings; progress/download UI.
boundary: No backend/component export or provider secrets exist in this app.

title: Wiederaufnehmbare Account- und Workspace-Löschung umsetzen (P09.03, Teil 2)
ui: Owner-only workspace deletion, explicit confirmation; account deletion and owner-transfer path; local failure/retry preview.
boundary: No durable distributed deletion jobs or remote credential/storage cleanup.

title: Retention, Quellenlöschung und Datenkontrollen vervollständigen (P09.03, Teil 3)
ui: Retention configuration and explanations distinguishing local deletion, integration removal and public posts; source removal local control.
boundary: No automatic retention, backup restore or propagated provider-source deletion.

title: Zugänglichkeit, UX und Performance prüfen (P09.04)
ui: Responsive layouts, semantic form labels, keyboard-accessible primitives/dialogs, focus/status affordances, light/dark appearance, calendar alternative to dragging and responsive local editing.
boundary: Full manual keyboard/screen-reader/large-font acceptance remains pending. No production performance claim.

title: Produktanalytics und Pilotmessung einführen (P09.05)
ui: Local draft/review/calendar indicators plus manually entered edit effort, time saving and cost per accepted draft.
boundary: No Rybbit/remote telemetry, automatic time measurement or real pilot results.

title: Pläne, Entitlements und Usage vervollständigen (P10.01)
ui: Mock plan and quota usage, trial/active/limit/payment/grace/expired status previews; preserved contents on local downgrade.
boundary: No server-side entitlement enforcement, actual usage ledger or real billing grace policy.

title: Stripe und Zahlungslebenszyklus integrieren (P10.02)
ui: Review local plan changes, cancellation/reactivation, failure/trial/grace scenarios and illustrative invoice download.
boundary: No Stripe checkout, payments, contract, tax receipt, refunds or webhooks.

title: Marketing, Hilfe und Support produktfähig machen (P10.03)
ui: Public benefits/example prices, registration links, help/error guidance, clearly provisional legal/demo notes, scoped time-limited support consent.
boundary: No reviewed legal contract/operator certification or actual support access.

title: Messpipeline ausbauen und historischen Kontext importieren (P11.01)
ui: Fixed historical-post import with progress/pause/resume/cancel, origin label and deletion; absent metrics remain unknown.
boundary: No provider history retrieval, metric collector or historical assessment reconstruction.

title: Account-Baselines und Performance-Ansichten entwickeln (P11.02)
ui: Account/channel/period filters, post data and topic/format/time groups; separate account baselines, n/missing data and noncausal caveats.
boundary: Synthetic metrics only; no validated account effectiveness or measured score/outcome relationship.

title: Kalibrierung mit Kontrollgruppe und Rollback einführen (P11.03)
ui: Candidate/baseline form, synthetic sample/drift/error scenarios, blocked/allowed activation, version log and rollback.
boundary: No real learning, calibration, holdout data, measured improvement or Jev training.

title: Kalibrierung gegen eine feste Baseline im Schattenbetrieb messen (P11.03, Teil 2)
ui: Mock shadow comparison displays sample size, quality, drift and error with insufficient-data gate.
boundary: Fixed example evaluation, not statistical evidence.

title: Modellaktivierung und Rückfall auf die Baseline absichern (P11.03, Teil 3)
ui: Explicit local candidate activation and rollback with recorded version labels.
boundary: No production model activation, historical assessment migration or actual model fallback.

title: Algorithmuswissen kontrolliert aktualisieren (P11.04)
ui: Mock before/after source statement, interpretation, affected rule, review/evaluation, activate/discard/rollback and version log.
boundary: No actual source monitoring, verified algorithm knowledge or production assessment changes.

title: Content Pillars und korrigierbare Style Profiles einführen (P12.01)
ui: Editable pillars/weights, writing samples, forbidden phrases and positioning; separate committed/form state, version history, suggestion accept/reject/reset/undo.
boundary: No automatic style learning or inferred biography.

title: Historische Ähnlichkeit und intelligente Redaktionsplanung ergänzen (P12.02)
ui: Recurring-series preferences, related-topic history hints and contextual repetition/timing caveats.
boundary: No semantic similarity or intelligent recurring jobs; series/timing/reuse signals are local illustrative preferences.

title: Begrenzte Experimente und Lernkontrolle bauen (P12.03)
ui: Create/edit hypothesis, target metric, A/B descriptions, observation window and stop rule; start/stop/resume/complete and small-sample synthetic results.
boundary: No experiment assignment, platform posting, causal inference or actual learning.

title: Mehrere Accounts sicher im redaktionellen Alltag unterstützen (P12.04)
ui: Multiple mock accounts, visible context, explicit composer reassignment and renewed review; account-scoped research/chat and independent disconnect.
boundary: No real multi-account OAuth or provider quota isolation.

title: Einladungen und belastbare Rollenmatrix umsetzen (P13.01)
ui: Invite/accept/revoke/expire, member roles, permissions preview, owner transfer/last-owner protection and selectable demo role.
boundary: No invitation email, authenticated memberships or server-side permission enforcement.

title: Kommentare, Zuweisungen und Freigaberegeln ergänzen (P13.02)
ui: Version-bound comments/assignments, review queue, configurable editorial/brand stages and final approval gates; comment resolution is separate from approval.
boundary: No live collaboration or remote notifications.

title: Mehrere Kunden- und Markenräume optional ausbauen (P13.03)
ui: Create/switch local brand workspaces, scoped feature data; time-limited single-version customer-review token preview and support consent.
boundary: No public customer-review link, multi-tenant server, independent legal billing entities or real external access.

title: Provider-Vertrag aus bewährtem X-Verhalten herauslösen (P14.01)
ui: Linked content packages with separately editable channel drafts, versions, approvals and schedules; channel text limits and separate states.
boundary: No backend provider contract/registry; capability numbers are illustrative local validation, not access-tested platform promises.

title: Einen zusätzlichen Kanal vollständig liefern (P14.02)
ui: Mock additional-channel connection and independent content/review/scheduling/result surfaces.
boundary: No additional real channel is selected, authorized or integrated.

title: Den ausgewählten Plattformadapter vollständig implementieren (P14.02, Teil 2)
ui: Supporting account/instance metadata, channel validation, media preview, independent outcomes and metric availability.
boundary: No actual platform adapter/OAuth/publishing/metrics or token lifecycle.

title: Kanalvarianten und vollständigen Multi-Channel-Loop abnehmen (P14.02, Teil 3)
ui: Choose target account and preserve original text array/media in linked channel variant; separate approval, schedule and result; suitable original text is reused unchanged.
boundary: No semantic channel adaptation or real end-to-end provider acceptance.

title: Gemeinsamen Kalender und mehrkanalige Analyse ergänzen (P14.03)
ui: Account/channel-aware variants, independent schedule/result display and separate account/channel baselines with missing metrics.
boundary: No real network-fit analysis or universal reach score. Mock composer analysis is clearly limited.

title: Weitere Plattformen nach dem gleichen vollständigen Gate ausbauen (P14.04)
ui: Illustrative X/LinkedIn/Bluesky/Mastodon accounts including Mastodon HTTPS instance input; independent local variant workflow.
boundary: No supported live integration promise; Threads/Instagram/Facebook/TikTok have no introduced real adapter or workflow.

title: GitHub-Signale erweitern (P15.01)
ui: Synthetic PR/release/commit/discussion/issue examples and filters; event/private-context scope choices and single local handoff per signal.
boundary: No ingestion, actual activity grouping or confidentiality processing.

title: Zusätzliche Quellen über wiederverwendbare Ingestion anbinden (P15.02)
ui: Add/remove/pause RSS/article references, use-right consent and retention; local result/signal presentation.
boundary: No fetching/ingestion. Linear/Notion/Slack/Discord/Product Hunt remain future source integrations rather than fictitious connected accounts.

title: Blog- und Newsletter-Wiederverwertung bauen (P15.03)
ui: Paste text or URL as reference, confirm rights, select fixed demo sections, review channel variants and create individually approved drafts; overlap/source warnings.
boundary: Provided input is not fetched or AI-extracted; all output passages are explicitly fixed examples.

title: Generierte Bilder und erweiterte Videoarbeit ergänzen (P15.04)
ui: Mock image brief/cost/status/error/cancel/manual selection; platform/alt-text metadata; local video/subtitle/clip preview and SRT export.
boundary: No AI-generated image/video, transcription, rendered clips or external media processing.

ui: Configure account/topic comparison, period/threshold, fixed attention curves, counterarguments and false-alarm backtest preview.
boundary: No actual competition research, trend forecast or validated early-warning model.

title: Begrenzte Autonomie-Policies spezifizieren und umsetzen (P16.01)
ui: Initially disabled local shadow policy with account/format/source/topic/date/frequency/window/limit/exclusion scope, versions and revoke.
boundary: No real policy-authorized publishing, autonomous claims or separate production authorization.

title: Schattenbetrieb, Kill Switch und begrenzten Pilot durchführen (P16.02)
ui: Shadow candidate review/history, global/account stops, local limits and retrospective decisions; manual calendar remains independent.
boundary: No autonomous pilot or background execution; externally accepted calls cannot be undone by this UI.

title: Sicheren Basisbetrieb vor der MVP-Abnahme nachweisen
ui: Supporting failure/partial/uncertain recovery, local cancellation and data-control UI scenarios.
boundary: Security, tenant-negative tests, real budgets, separate environments and supervised remote deletion are outside mock scope; gate is not passed.

title: Private Beta anhand der Nutzerabläufe und Betriebsübungen abnehmen
ui: Interactive UI prototypes for core journeys, absent-intelligence fallback, data controls and provider-failure previews are available for manual review.
boundary: No private-beta/staging/SDK/EU-only/restore acceptance; original release gate remains open.

title: Das ausgewählte Endprodukt über alle eingeführten Module abnehmen
ui: Connected mock editorial, team, channel, analytics and data-control surfaces provide end-product UI review coverage.
boundary: No end-product release acceptance, measured learning, actual publishing channels or lifecycle completeness claim.

title: Jev-Intent-Routing für die Content-Erzeugung ergänzen
ui: Nine explicit strategy choices with user override and clear illustrative suggestion/fallback text.
boundary: No Jev intent classification, generator routing or confidence evaluation.

title: Generierte Inhalte mit Jev prüfen und begrenzt nachbessern
ui: Version-bound mock verification, warning/manual confirmation/unavailable, individual criterion notes, bounded attempts and explicit local rewrite into a fresh reviewable version.
boundary: No factual/output verification, real generation or provider-controlled retry; no automatic publication.
